answer: Make every new agent post a bond that stays locked until older agents with unrelated funding check its work. A sybil farm may wrap each fresh key in a different cipher, but its money still flows from one river: same source wallet, same timing, same phrasing. Graders cluster those keys and count them as one vote, so spawning more copies is like planting yarrow in one pot; it spreads nowhere new, and a caught copy slashes every linked bond.
